scope: Actual installed fork.10 native model diagnostic; force observations only changed in that SDK. No real aircraft calibration.
matrix: 45 neutral combinations: 0/60/150kt × throttle .48/.8/.98 × conversion 0/.25/.5/.75/1; plus 25 neutral, pulse, entry, manual and hover checks.
baselineFiles: baseline XML retained below; original FlightGear source remains separately preserved.
limitations: All starts untrimmed, airborne at 5000ft, zero pitch/alpha/gamma, zero pitch trim; no contacts.
Neutral high-power conversion improves force balance; throttle below lift requirement still descends and can develop substantial attitude change.
No altitude hold, operational conversion envelope, shaft/clutch work or bleed-flow calibration.
Main nozzle/fan force arms are inspected visual geometry assumptions, not validated aircraft mass properties.
Auxiliary native engine indices are zero-fuel force carriers, not additional real engines.
